name: taskflow-v2-mcp
description: TaskFlow v2 MCP server + Claude Code hooks — an agent client that drives the TaskFlow backend agent API using a stable .taskflow.json credential.
//bin: Deliberately NOT `taskflow-mcp`: the legacy @dalmasonto/taskflow-mcp already owns that name globally, and npm would silently overwrite its symlink. The `-v2-` names let both live side by side.

scripts.//build: chmod is not decoration: `bin` is exec'd by name, and tsc emits 0644. npm sets the bit at install time, so a rebuild over an EXISTING dist inherits it and looks fine — but a clean build (rm -rf dist) emits a fresh, non-executable file and every launch then fails with EACCES.
